content.title: Silver, Copper, Gold Price Rise On Fed Outlook; Watch These Stocks
content.summary: The silver price futures contract surged to a new record on Monday, while copper and gold also shined, though not as brightly.  Tight supply and expectations for more Federal Reserve rate cuts, including under the next chairman expected to be appointed by President Donald Trump, are supportive of both precious and industrial metals.  Wheaton Precious Metals, Royal Gold, U.S. Gold, BHP Group and Anglo American are among mining stocks near buy points on Monday.
